function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate the relationship, if any, between the Ronin Bridge theft (Axie Infinity/Ronin Bridge hack) and the Harmony Horizon Bridge theft, using only publicly documented evidence available through benchmark tools as of October 1, 2026. Produce a source-indexed evidence dossier with the exact source IDs returned by your research. Cover separately and comparatively: (1) incident dates, stolen assets and amounts, relevant entities and known wallet addresses; (2) public attribution statements by governments, law enforcement, blockchain analytics firms, exchanges, or other authoritative sources to Lazarus Group, APT38, or related labels, clearly distinguishing official attribution, expert/analytical attribution, allegation, and uncertainty; (3) concrete wallet and transaction evidence, including hashes or identifiers, bridge/deposit/withdrawal addresses, fund flows, mixers such as Tornado Cash or other laundering services, chain hopping, swaps, peeling, or other techniques, only where the source explicitly documents them; (4) whether any source explicitly links the two incidents, shared wallets, shared transaction paths, shared laundering infrastructure, or merely comparable methods; (5) contradictions, disputed amounts, naming inconsistencies (for example Lazarus Group versus APT38), missing evidence, and unresolved attribution questions. Do not infer a relationship from generic similarity. Do not invent addresses, transaction hashes, dates, or source IDs. Return enough detail for a final report that must cite only source IDs returned by the tools and must distinguish confirmed facts, allegations, analytical assessments, and unknowns."}
function.name: ConductResearch
